title: Generative Monte Carlo Sampling for Constant-Cost Particle Transport
abstract: arXiv:2512.13965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Generative Monte Carlo (GMC), a novel paradigm for particle transport simulation that integrates generative artificial intelligence directly into the stochastic solution of the linear Boltzmann equation. By reformulating the cell-transmission problem as a conditional generation task, we train neural networks using conditional flow matching to sample particle exit states, including position, direction, and path length, without simulating scattering histories. The method employs optical coordinate scaling, enabling a single trained model to generalize across any material. We validate GMC on two canonical benchmarks, namely a heterogeneous lattice problem characteristic of nuclear reactor cores and a linearized hohlraum geometry representative of high-energy density radiative transfer. translated_title: 生成式蒙特卡洛采样用于恒定成本粒子输运
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.13965v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：我们提出了生成式蒙特卡洛（GMC），一种新颖的粒子输运模拟范式，它将生成式人工智能直接集成到线性玻尔兹曼方程的随机求解中。通过将单元传输问题重新表述为条件生成任务，我们使用条件流匹配训练神经网络，以采样粒子出射状态，包括位置、方向和路径长度，而无需模拟散射历史。该方法采用光学坐标缩放，使单个训练模型能够推广到任何材料。我们在两个典型基准上验证了GMC，即核反应堆堆芯特征的异构晶格问题和代表高能量密度辐射输运的线性化黑腔几何。结果表明，GMC保持了标准蒙特卡洛的统计保真度，表现出预期的$1/\sqrt{N}$收敛速率。
tldr: 本文提出生成式蒙特卡洛（GMC），通过条件流匹配神经网络直接采样粒子出射状态，无需模拟散射历史，实现了恒定成本且跨材料通用的粒子输运模拟，并保持标准蒙特卡洛的统计精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Generative Monte Carlo (GMC), which uses conditional flow matching neural networks to directly sample particle exit states without simulating scattering histories, enabling constant-cost and material-agnostic particle transport simulation while preserving standard Monte Carlo statistical fidelity.
